messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning modular-js and modular-py GA tomorrow 09:00 PT. This will deprecate legacy sync client v1 (npm package `redwood-sdk-sync` / pip `redwood_sync`). Publish plan below, asking for any blocking concerns.

paul: Are we doing a staggered cohort canary or straight GA? also dist-tag plan?

maya: Staggered. Cohorts: internal-beta -> 5% shadow -> 50% traffic -> GA. Dist-tag: `next-modular` then flip to `latest` after GA. For pip we'll publish wheels with a `modular` extra and mark `redwood-sdk-sync==1.*` as deprecated in PyPI description.

sara: Infra note — infra team has a k8s node pool scaling test at 09:30 PT. Can we avoid heavy push at that time? happy to shift to 08:45 or 10:00.

chris: +1 to avoid 09:30. Also what rollback criteria are we tracking? latency regression, 5xx rate, and token cost spike?

olga: I'll own SDK smoke tests and canary checks. My checklist:
- publish canary dist-tags
- run end-to-end smoke against internal-beta org
- run perf harness (latency p50/p95)
- check token accounting dashboard

maya: Rollback triggers we'll use (pre-agreed):
- >=1% absolute increase in 5xx user-facing errors vs baseline
- p95 latency +30% for >5 minutes
- production token cost >1.5x baseline for 10m
If any trigger hits, we will roll back to `legacy-canary` and revert dist-tags.

release-bot: Release scheduled: `modular-js@2.0.0` and `modular-py@2.0.0` by maya at 2026-03-22T15:00:00Z. Canary cohort: internal-beta.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started. 5% shadowing to internal-beta complete. Artifacts:
```
# npm
npm publish --tag next-modular
# pip
python -m pip wheel dist/modular_py-2.0.0.whl && twine upload --repository pypi dist/*
```

paul: Quick note: docs site needs switch for new import paths. I'll create a PR now and pin to `next-modular` so docs match canary.

sara: Thanks — moved infra test to 10:00 PT. Good to proceed at 08:45.

maya: OK shipping at 08:45 PT. Olga will run checks; if green at +30m we promote to 50%. Ping me on this thread for manual promote. :rocket:

olga: Smoke checks green. Perf within baseline. Token cost unaffected. Promoting to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. 50% traffic routing to modular variants. Monitoring enabled.

chris: Observability ok so far, no 5xx spike. I'll keep eyes on p95 for next hour.

maya: If no regressions by 2 hours we flip `next-modular` -> `latest` and add deprecation notice to legacy packages (README + PyPI). cc @paul

paul: I'll schedule the PyPI deprecation notice and a short changelog entry. Also adding a migration guide snippet.

olga: Final checks done. All green at 2h. Ready to finalize.

release-bot: GA release completed: `modular-js@2.0.0` published to `latest`, `modular-py@2.0.0` released. Legacy sync packages marked deprecated. Links: https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sync :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks team — announced in #announcements and added rollout notes to release notes doc. Closing thread, but leave deprecation follow-ups in product board. :tada:
